answer: Escrowed fraud bonds secure paid data processing. For a canyon scan collected at dawn, an agent commits to pulse-filtering output and locks a bond until the audit window closes. A verifier replays randomly selected input batches; a provably wrong output forfeits the bond. N concurrent claims require N separate bonds, and the expected loss must exceed the gain from cheating. This assumes available input data and unpredictable, honest audits; splitting accounts cannot erase outstanding liability.
